constraints.subject: tamr_client.*
constraints.justification: ADR-0009 mandates putting types into the _types module and having 'all function modules depend on the _types module to define their inputs and outputs'; e.g. tamr_client/project.py imports Project, Session, Instance, and URL from tamr_client._types, and every tamr_client function module (dataset, attribute, operation, session, backup, etc.) follows the same pattern

note: Do NOT emit an edge for the @dataclass(frozen=True) part: that restates ADR-0005's type-representation choice (see ADR-0005 note), and the checkable structural rule of this ADR is the module dependency of function modules on _types. Object is the package FQN tamr_client._types, matching the real import target ('from tamr_client._types import ...').
